what_happened: Discovered via gh run view --log on all 3 failing docs.yml runs that leanprover-community/docgen-action's own internal 'Cache Mathlib docs' actions/cache step (post-if: success()) has NEVER saved, because the job always fails from OOM before reaching a success() state. This forces every run to cold-build the full ~6,300-target Mathlib+deps docInfo fan-out instead of restoring it, which is the dominant driver of the process-spawn ENOMEM -- a materially different and more actionable root cause than concurrency tuning (LEAN_NUM_THREADS) or swap size, both of which leave the fan-out count unchanged.
